Missing required.why: A required field must be filled. Any gap is a Check; more than 1% is a Fail.

Missing optional.why: Optional fields can be empty by design. Above 25% is a Check. Never a Fail.

Hidden missing.why: Text like NA in a cell hides a missing value from software that only looks for empty cells.

Empty columns.why: A column with no values at all. Shown for information, never a Fail.

Half-empty columns.why: Columns where more than half the rows are empty. Shown for information, never a Fail.

Duplicate IDs.why: An ID or key should appear once.

Mixed types.why: Text inside a number column breaks number parsing.

Label variants.why: The same label written different ways splits one group into two.

Extra spaces.why: Leading or trailing spaces make equal values look different.

Wrong format.why: Value breaks the format rule written in the check.

Not allowed value.why: Value not in the allowed list from the standard or data dictionary.

Format style.why: Value is right but written in an unusual style (for example 1188.0 for a whole number). Never a Fail.
